source.title: Johnson and Graham, High-Speed Signal Propagation, chapter 6, Table 6.1
source.method: Method-of-moments magnetic simulator;120 segments per trace; linear current variation; author estimates +/-2% (not a rigorous bound)

scope: Supplementary published conductor-R comparison only; incomplete nominal copper thickness prevents exact-reference claim. Nonmagnetic mask excluded from magnetic R; no C, Z or attenuation comparison.
normalization: Table loop RAC = 2*(R11-R12) = 2*Rodd. At 100 ohm differential impedance, 60.7/(2*100)*20/log(10)=2.636 dB/m agrees with table 2.63.

thicknessBracket.meaning: Nominal one-ounce conversion conventions 1.35 and 1.4 mil; not a manufacturing tolerance or claimed exact thickness. All endpoints evaluated without selecting by result.

referencePlane.state: Explicit thick-plane hypothesis; published reference thickness unspecified; canonical surface model assumes thickness much greater than skin depth.
